reasons_add: Abū al-ʿĀliya specifies despair when harm touches the person. Al-Samarrāʾī says giving to the poor counters both grief when wealth leaves and denial of the needy person's share.
Al-Samarrāʾī says giving to the poor cures both reactions: the donor does not grieve as though afflicted when wealth leaves and does not withhold the needy person's share.
Al-Samarrāʾī presents giving to the poor as the corrective act that prevents withholding the needy person's share.
Al-Samarrāʾī connects giving to the poor in 70:24–25 with curing both sides of halūʿ: grief at losing wealth and denial of the needy person's share.
